authorization: 2026-10-13 user explicitly authorizes Phase3 backtests, input integration, verification, sealing, publication and existing-site production deployment

phase2_context.role: descriptive frozen midpoint/protected-boundary event context only; no trading cross-product

timing.latest_cloud: latest expected completed same-contract usable slot; missing latest slot is unknown, never older-row forward-fill
timing.order_decision_snapshot: actual first submission plus inferred original-source 15m recalculation/update closes while flat/unconsumed before fixed first shadow event
timing.entry_snapshot: available at original execution minute opening/lower bound; separately labeled and never used retrospectively for entry gates
timing.full_post_fill_monitoring: 5m opening >= conservative original fill upper time bound
timing.contact_level: prior valid completed cloud available at contact opening
timing.execution: next scheduled eligible observed opening within original broker window; unavailable expected execution is censored
timing.unknown_entry_cloud: known declared abstention, separately counted feature-unknown
timing.unknown_open_cloud: no new EMA action; original protection remains active; confirmation chains reset
timing.unknown_support_prefix: any unknown full post-fill expected prior/current cloud or usable state before/during arming can hide the first setup; consume unknown attempt and abstain for episode, retain original protection

slopes.definition: EMA[k]-EMA[k-3]; strict directional sign; no slope requirement in cloud definition

entry_gates.G1: direction ordering and last completed close strictly beyond favorable cloud edge
entry_gates.G2: G1 plus both three-change slopes with original direction
entry_gates.updates: original complete usable 15m source order-decision closes; gate held until next such update
entry_gates.shadow_monitor: causal virtual unfiltered boundary OCA event on inherited 1m authored path; first event consumes original day and cancels other side even if blocked
entry_gates.cancellation_latency: first submission tied to original opening inherits parent ordering; later update tied to shadow-minute opening with changed admission preserves unknown fill/cancel branches; unchanged admission unaffected; native latency unverified

support_adds.liquidation_requirement: strictly positive estimated net liquidation after inherited entry/exit commissions and adverse exit slippage
support_adds.arming: full post-fill candle wholly beyond prior available entire cloud; strict low>upper for long or high<lower for short
support_adds.contact: first separate later penetration of chosen prior available EMA consumes entire episode add attempt
support_adds.confirmation: strict close back on original trade side of frozen contact level and current EMA ordering aligned
support_adds.pending_add_priority: parent queued opening exit or opening gap-stop before contingent add release; cancel if flat; retain already-filled add after later parent exit
support_adds.unresolved_competition: retain ambiguity and unresolved outcome bounds, never retrospectively delete executed add
support_adds.initial_stop: 1% of signal close with inherited tick rounding
support_adds.add_reset: actual slipped fill at close of surviving full 5m add entry candle
support_adds.parent_reset: unchanged surviving original 15m entry candle reset
support_adds.exit: own protection or common inherited evening opening; no profit target

early_exits.X1: first full post-fill close beyond prior adverse edge freezes that edge; second adjacent expected usable close strictly beyond SAME edge queues next-opening exit; recovery/equality/unknown resets
early_exits.X2: adjacent expected usable full post-fill observations aligned or neutral -> strictly opposed; initial opposition is not a fresh cross
early_exits.opening_priority: inherited queued market exit before opening stop, with competing orders recorded

monotone_ema50.ratchet: tighten only; preserve tighter original protection and never loosen at original reset
monotone_ema50.already_breached_at_decision: next-opening market exit; never historical stop fill

costs.kind: inherited assumed scenarios, not actual broker charges

accounts.diagnostic: explicitly unfunded one-original-plus-one-added whole-GC diagnostic versus one- and two-contract parent; extra exposure, not equal-risk improvement; no assumed increase in source capital
accounts.quantity_risk_reference: inherit raw submitted boundary-to-stop distance for original; analogous raw signal-close-to-stop distance for add; commissions, slippage and gaps reported as risk overshoots rather than silently changing parent sizing

core_estimands.G1: net one-GC gate policy minus unchanged one-GC Phase1 parent per original accepted episode
core_estimands.G2: net one-GC gate policy minus unchanged one-GC Phase1 parent per original accepted episode
core_estimands.A20: net financed half-parent/half-add overlay minus financed half-budget parent alone per original accepted episode; source $10000 account
core_estimands.A50: net financed half-parent/half-add overlay minus financed half-budget parent alone per original accepted episode; source $10000 account
core_estimands.X1: net one-GC exit policy minus unchanged one-GC Phase1 parent per original accepted episode
core_estimands.X2: net one-GC exit policy minus unchanged one-GC Phase1 parent per original accepted episode
core_estimands.shared_mask: all six declared contrasts known on original episode; separately show individual complete-pair masks and incomparable units/exposure

evaluation.coverage: exact inherited parent available coverage; 2026 partial
prior_exposure: Study21 cloud source and historical studies
evaluation.selection: standalone only; validation mean effect>0 and 99.166667% adjusted lower>0 and >=100 completed executable policy trades across >=2 validation years; adds additionally require >=100 actually financed adds across >=2 years
evaluation.later_retesting: all fixed policies assessed without retuning; selection hashes and independent dev/validation verification precede later execution

uncertainty.family: six declared core policy/control contrasts within each reported cohort; not simultaneous over all profile/year/session/side combinations
uncertainty.within_episode_events_and_legs: kept aligned in calendar block resampling

profiles.duration_unknown_start: left-censored category, retain lower bound rather than invented exact duration
profiles.width_change: current width minus width three completed expected usable observations earlier; strict expanding/contracting/equal
profiles.confluence: each EMA within inclusive0.10*positiveATR14 of frozenH/L/M
profiles.probability_model: not fitted; empirical conditional support only

retest_diagnostics.rearming: new separate later full departure wholly beyond prior cloud after consumed contact; independent eachEMA; repeated contact only diagnostic, never another add
retest_diagnostics.touch: first later selectedEMA penetration after departure
retest_diagnostics.one_tick_breach: full raw EMA adverse one-tick displacement; executable long threshold floor(frozenEMA/0.1)*0.1-0.1, short ceil(frozenEMA/0.1)*0.1+0.1; touch and strict close use unrounded frozen raw EMA
retest_diagnostics.close_break: strict close beyond adverse side of frozen contact level
retest_diagnostics.hold: strict close back on trade side of frozen contact level
retest_diagnostics.reclaim: separate later valid close back on trade side of same frozen breached contact level, through broker cutoff; price diagnostic may occur after parent exit
retest_diagnostics.forward_definition: from confirmed event close; source candle excluded, next exact wall-clock minutes; signed close movement/MFE/MAE; missing or cutoff-crossing horizon censored, not trade returns

reporting.transitions: original_entry -> cloud_event -> actual_add_entry; no invented unfilled add session

contact_context.ordering_flip: contact prior aligned/neutral -> contact-close strictly opposed, both expected cloud snapshots valid; unknown remains null; descriptive not X2 signal
contact_context.range_confluence: selected frozen prior EMA within inclusive0.10 positive ATR14 of H/L/M; yes/no/unknown
contact_context.cohorts: EMA event year/session and original side; conditional open-position contacts

extra_exposure_diagnostic_comparison.alternative: one original plus at most one added GC, independently A20/A50
extra_exposure_diagnostic_comparison.common_mask: alternative plus both known controls per original episode

risk_metadata_tick_identity.scope: Canonical tick identity for signed protective-risk/R metadata only; every raw/slipped price, order/fill path and raw sizing distance preserved
risk_metadata_tick_identity.parent_saved_numbers: unchanged Phase1 control rows retain their executed statistics

entry_context_paths.source: known completed pinned Phase1 rows; exact frozen-parent conditional means
entry_context_paths.later_ema_anchors: unavailable to avoid claiming whole-parent pre-event excursions as post-event paths
